promotion_condition: After generating 120-127 strict signatures and pre-factor manifests, factor only gate-selected surfaces and score target_root_hash. Count as a scan-positive promotion only if all gate-selected surfaces are preserving, false-positive-free, and below Pollard rho under scan accounting. Count as a weaker direct-root positive if all are preserving, false-positive-free, and below rho only under direct-root accounting.
